features: BROWSE & READ EBOOKS IN FULL COLOUR – Book covers, comics, graphic novels, illustrations, note-taking and more come to life. No glare in sunlight, no notifications – just you and your eBooks in full-colour
YOUR JOURNAL, DAILY PLANNER AND MORE – Dive into your stories with colorful markups. With Kobo Stylus 2* compatibility (*sold separately), annotate, highlight, and note take your eBooks in color
READ COMFORTABLY, ALWAYS – Ergonomically designed with page-turn buttons, left/right screen rotation, full font size and margin customization, and landscape mode
IPX8 WATERPROOF EREADER – Full waterproof protection and meets requirements of IPX8 rating – waterproof for up to 60 minutes in up to 2 metres of water
BETTER BY DESIGN – Thoughtfully made with recycled and ocean-bound plastic and repairability to waterproof protection
CARRY THOUSANDS OF BOOKS ANYWHERE – Carry up to 24,000 eBooks or 150 Kobo Audiobooks with 32GB of storage and enjoy weeks of battery life
ENDLESS WAYS TO READ & LISTEN- Shop the Kobo Store for millions of eBooks and audiobooks, and read saved articles with Pocket.
Compatibility Notice: This eReader is not compatible with Mac or Windows systems for direct device integration or file management.
